question: Calculate the area of the triangle whose sides are 8 cm, 9 cm and 13 cm. (Rounded up to two decimal places)
solution:
**Given:**

Side a = 8 cm

Side b = 9 cm

Side c = 13 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of triangle = sqrt{s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)}

Where, s = Semi-perimeter = (a+b+c)/(2)

**Calculation:**

s = (8+9+13)/(2) 

⇒ s = 15 cm

Area = sqrt{15(15-8)(15-9)(15-13)} 

⇒ Area = sqrt{15 times 7 times 6 times 2}

⇒ Area = sqrt{1260} 

⇒ Area ≈ 35.50 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
